• *Source/Speaker:* Citi and HSBC
• *Announcement:* Global brokerages Citi and HSBC have turned more bullish on Indian equities\, with Citi raising its end\-2027 Nifty 50 target to 28\,000 and HSBC upgrading India's equity rating while trimming its China outlook\.
• *Market Stance:* 🟢 BULLISH

📊 *CONFIDENCE LEVEL:* MEDIUM \(75\% \- Major transnational corporations have issued explicit market outlooks and target revisions\)\.

🎯 *INDIAN MARKET IMPACT:*
• *Vulnerable Sectors:* OGCs\, Chemicals
• *Strategic Tailwinds:* IT\, EMS\, Metals/Auto\, Pharma\, Textiles
• *Expected FII Sentiment:* Net Inflows \(Global brokerages are increasing their bullish stance on India\, and a "China\+1" shift is evident\, driving capital to Indian markets despite some identified domestic risks\)\.

💡 *TACTICAL ACTIONABLE OUTCOME:* Consider overweighting broad market ETFs or large\-cap Indian equities\, particularly in IT\, while monitoring for potential downside risks in OGCs and Chemicals related to fuel and fertilizer costs\.
